children: Regulatory Judgement: Governance and Financial Viability
GreenSquareAccord Limited (the Issuer) £400,000,000 5.25 per cent Bonds due 30 November 2047 (ISIN XS2560035201).

The Issuer announces that the Regulator of Social Housing has today issued a regulatory judgement in respect of the Issuer. The Issuer's Governance grading has been downgraded from G2 to G3. Its Viability grading has been downgraded from V2 to V3. Its Consumer grading of C2, issued on 29 October 2025, remains unchanged.
A copy of that judgement can be found here: GreenSquareAccord Limited (LH3902): Regulatory Judgement - 7 October 2026 - GOV.UK

Further information regarding the Issuer's plan on addressing the issues highlighted by the Regulator of Social Housing can be found here on their website. The Issuer will also be publishing a six-month trading update for the 2026/27 financial year in due course.
For further information contact Mona Shah, Chief Finance and Investment Officer (mona.shah@greensquareaccord.co.uk).
